note: Full reversed/Molt overlay for all 22 Major Arcana. Each card adds a 'reversed' block (one of the five modes, RWS-accurate reading mapped to the bird archetype, plus a one-line gameplay hint) and a 'molt' art-direction block. uprightMeaning aliases each source card's coreMeaning verbatim. Dark Majors lean toward the renewal mode where tradition does. The six worked Majors from reversals-sample.json (The Fool, The Emperor, Strength, Death, The Tower, The Sun) are reused verbatim.
accentMoltRule: warm+inward/deficiency -> drained ash; any+shadow/renewal -> oil-slick iridescent; cool+blocked -> frost-dimmed
